# ResumeMatch

> ResumeMatch is a web-based resume screening tool for recruiters and hiring teams.

## Official pages

- Homepage: https://resumematch.co.in/
- Free demo: https://resumematch.co.in/demo
- Resume parser: https://resumematch.co.in/resume-parser
- Documentation: https://resumematch.co.in/docs
- Blog: https://resumematch.co.in/blog
- Privacy policy: https://resumematch.co.in/privacy

## What it does

ResumeMatch accepts PDF and DOCX resumes, extracts job-relevant requirements, and compares candidates against a job description. Results show matched, missing, and implied skills with supporting resume evidence.

## Responsible-use note

ResumeMatch is a prioritization aid, not an automatic hiring decision. Recruiters should inspect the underlying resume, verify requirements, and apply consistent human review.

## Product positioning

ResumeMatch is designed for small recruiting teams, staffing agencies, HR teams, and hiring managers who want explainable screening without adopting a full enterprise ATS.
